== Article notes ==

=== Build notes ===
* Card list taken from the slip captions in [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf VirtualBlock8_1.pdf] (the title above each slip, not the original-card label in its corner); links follow the [[Virtual Block 8]] card list. Sides come from the PDF's Dark Side and Light Side pages.
* Cards printed under an earlier name, matched to the later card by game text (swccg-card-json legacy data):
** The Mandalorian, Father Of Fett = [[Jango Fett, The Assassin]]
** Rebel Agent = [[Kyle Katarn]]
** Booster's Star Destroyer (V) = [[Errant Venture]]
** Rebel Agent's Blaster Rifle = [[Kyle Katarn's Blaster Rifle]]
* Article created as a test for Bill; title uses the "(Virtual Block N)" suffix for all twelve releases because Domain Of Evil, Scoundrels and Republic At War already have pages. Source PDF not yet saved to the Internet Archive (queued).
